messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Announce: Distance 6.0 Release 1
parts:
Distance users,

I have just uploaded a new version of Distance to the web site

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

This is the first public release of Distance 6.0, and it is a
recommended download for all users. Installation instructions, plus a
list of new features, changes and fixes, is in the readme file, which
comes with the install package and is also available at

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/downloads/readme6.rtf

Cheers to all,

- Len Thomas


--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling
The Observatory, University of St Andrews, Scotland KY16 9LZ

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
Distance home page: http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/
